title: Mexican Causa with Grilled Chicken and Apple Salsa
description: A Peruvian-inspired Mexican dish featuring grilled chicken, creamy causa, and a fresh apple salsa.
instructions: Preheat grill to medium-high heat. Season chicken with salt and pepper. Grill for 5-7 minutes per side or until cooked through.
Cut cooked chicken into small pieces.
To make apple salsa, peel and chop apples. Chop red onion and cilantro. Mix all ingredients together and season with lime juice.
Cook causa according to package instructions.
Assemble causa by spreading a layer of causa on a plate, followed by a layer of chicken, and then a layer of apple salsa.
Garnish with nutritious lettuce leaves and a drizzle of limena dressing (or serve with lime wedges).
Chill all ingredients in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes before serving for a more refreshing dish.
If desired, top with additional salsa, lime juice, or cilantro for added flavor.
Consider serving with tortilla chips or toasted bread for a fun twist on the dish.
